reason: A offers the clearer controlled test: near-isoelectronic radius substitution perturbs local strain while retaining the HEA constraint, with explicit baseline Tc/Hc2 measurements, phase checks, boundaries, and falsification criteria. Its cited evidence supports disorder-sensitive superconductivity only indirectly and substitution may still alter chemistry, but B is more compositionally confounded and provides no evidence for its asserted monotonic heavy-metal enhancement of electron–phonon coupling.
